C0532.title: China Construction Bank Credit Card Holders Frequently Targeted by Third-Party Debt Collection Agencies
C0532.summary: A May 2024 report highlights that consumer finance companies engaged in overdue loan collection have resorted to improper tactics such as violence, threats, intimidation, and harassment. CCB credit card holders are frequently subjected to aggressive harassment by third-party collection agencies.

references.title: Behind frequent third-party collection harassment for CCB credit card users - Sina News
